what: Horizon ring (land, sea, forest masses beyond the playable square to the camera far plane): cost per draw-distance level
source: src/scene/horizonField.ts buildHorizon / horizonBudget (exact geometry counts) and tools/render-preview/map.mjs measure (scene graph, SwiftShader, Medium). Frame times are not reported: SwiftShader is relative only and the machine was shared.
notes: Medium adds 2 draw calls and about 33k triangles, a quarter of the 131k-triangle terrain mesh. The map-wide frame totals in the before/after logs also contain other agents' merged work (animal rigs, materials), so only the horizon group is attributable to this change. The ring is rebuilt when the draw-distance level changes (including governor easing) and costs tens of ms on the CPU, not per frame.
